{{Current events|year=2005|month=01|day=29|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->

* A low-key and tightly controlled funeral is held for purged [[People's Republic of China|Chinese Communist]] leader [[Zhao Ziyang]].[http://www.cbc.ca/cp/world/050128/w012866.html (AP)][http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/4211157.stm (BBC)]
* [[Procter & Gamble]] plan to purchase competitor [[Gillette (brand)|Gillette]] in a deal worth $52.4 billion. Industry experts, including Gillette [[CEO]] [[Jim Kilts]], expect further industry consolidation this year, spurred in part by a 40% rise in oil prices last year and the need to gain clout against economic giant [[Wal-Mart]]. [http://quote.bloomberg.com/apps/news?pid=10000103&sid=aOnwXs1QSP88&refer=news_index (Bloomberg)]
* The first [[Three Links|direct flights]] between [[mainland China]] and [[Taiwan]] since [[Chinese Civil War|1949]] will take place in time for the [[Chinese New Year]].[http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory?id=452291 (Reuters)] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/4215889.stm (BBC)]
* A series of moderate-intensity [[aftershock]]s rattle the [[Andaman and Nicobar Islands]] and [[Sumatra]] in [[Indonesia]] over a month after the region was devastated by a [[earthquake|quake]]-generated [[tsunami]]. No casualties or damage is reported. [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/1005177.cms (Times of India)]
*The West Loop on the [[Sengkang LRT line]] in [[Singapore]] began operations for uni-directional operation with 5 stations: [[Thanggam LRT station|Thanggam]], [[Fernvale LRT station|Fernvale]], [[Layar LRT station|Layar]], [[Tongkang LRT station|Tongkang]] and [[Renjong LRT station|Renjong]] while the East Loop on the [[Punggol LRT line]] began operations for uni-directional operation with 5 stations: [[Cove LRT station|Cove]], [[Meridian LRT station|Meridian]], [[Coral Edge LRT station|Coral Edge]], [[Riviera MRT/LRT station|Riviera]] and [[Kadaloor LRT station|Kadaloor]], operated by [[SBS Transit|SBS Transit Ltd]] using [[Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Crystal Mover C810]]s.
